endorsements.name: Brett Casper
endorsements.label: CVE-2022-22776
endorsements.description: The Web Server component of TIBCO Software Inc.'s TIBCO BusinessConnect Trading Community Management contains easily exploitable vulnerabilities that allows a low privileged attacker with network access to execute Stored Cross Site Scripting (XSS) on the affected system. A successful attack using these vulnerabilities requires human interaction from a person other than the attacker. Affected releases are TIBCO Software Inc.'s TIBCO BusinessConnect Trading Community Management: versions 6.1.0 and below.
endorsements.subtitle: CVE · Severity: HIGH (CVSS 3.1, 8)

povs.explanation: A published CVE record provides public, independently verifiable recognition of the credited vulnerability disclosure.
